mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.CLASS_IDX, c.TITLE, c.CREATED_AT, c.PHOTO, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE,
u.USER_NAME AS PROVIDER_NAME,
NVL(r.AVG_RATING, 0) AS AVG_RATING, NVL(r.REVIEW_COUNT, 0) AS REVIEW_COUNT,
CASE WHEN c.START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND SYSDATE < c.START_DATE THEN '예정' WHEN c.END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND SYSDATE > c.END_DATE THEN '종료' ELSE '진행중' END AS PROGRESS_STATUS,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.CLASS_IDX DESC) AS RN FROM CLASS c LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_IDX = c.PROVIDER_IDX LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CLASS_IDX, ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) AS AVG_RATING, COUNT(*) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM REVIEW_CLASS GROUP BY CLASS_IDX ) r ON r.CLASS_IDX = c.CLASS_IDX ) t WHERE t.RN BETWEEN #{startRow, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND #{endRow, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

SELECT u.USER_IDX AS "users_idx", u.USER_NAME AS "users.user_name", u.STATUS AS "users.status", c.COMPANY_IDX AS "company.company_idx", c.COMPANY_NUM AS "company.company_num", nvl(ct.CERT_STATUS, 'INACTIVE') AS "cert_status" FROM USERS u JOIN COMPANY c ON c.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN CERT ct ON u.USER_IDX = ct.USER_IDX AND ct.CERT_TYPE = '사업증' WHERE u.USER_TYPE = 'COMPANY' ORDER BY c.COMPANY_IDX DESC

SELECT u.USER_IDX AS users_idx, u.USER_NAME AS "users.user_name", u.LOGIN_ID AS "users.login_id", u.STATUS AS "users.status", c.COMPANY_NUM AS "company.company_num", c.PHONE AS "company.phone", c.ADDRESS AS "company.address", c.EMAIL AS "company.email", cert.CERT_STATUS AS cert_status, e.START_DATE AS "embedded.start_date", e.END_DATE AS "embedded.end_date", e.REASON AS "embedded.reason" FROM USERS u JOIN COMPANY c ON c.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN CERT cert ON cert.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX AND cert.CERT_TYPE = '사업증' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e1.* FROM EMBEDDED_USER e1 WHERE e1.EMBED_USER_IDX IN ( SELECT MAX(e2.EMBED_USER_IDX) FROM EMBEDDED_USER e2 GROUP BY e2.USER_IDX ) ) e ON e.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX WHERE u.USER_IDX = #{usersIdx}

SELECT e.EMBED_USER_IDX AS embed_user_idx, e.USER_IDX AS user_idx, e.START_DATE AS start_date, e.END_DATE AS end_date, e.REASON AS reason FROM EMBEDDED_USER e WHERE e.EMBED_USER_IDX = ( SELECT MAX(e2.EMBED_USER_IDX) FROM EMBEDDED_USER e2 WHERE e2.USER_IDX = #{userIdx} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMBEDDED_USER ( EMBED_USER_IDX, USER_IDX, START_DATE, END_DATE, REASON ) VALUES ( SEQ_EMBED_USER.NEXTVAL, #{userIdx}, TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), CASE WHEN #{endDate} IS NULL OR #{endDate} = '' THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, #{reason} )
mapper.update: UPDATE EMBEDDED_USER SET END_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE EMBED_USER_IDX = ( SELECT MAX(e2.EMBED_USER_IDX) FROM EMBEDDED_USER e2 WHERE e2.USER_IDX = #{userIdx} )
UPDATE CERT SET CERT_STATUS = #{cert_status}, GET_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_IDX = #{user_idx} AND CERT_TYPE = '사업증'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CERT ( CERT_IDX, USER_IDX, CERT_NAME, CERT_TYPE, CERT_STATUS, GET_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_CERT.NEXTVAL, #{user_idx}, '사업자등록증', '사업증', #{cert_status}, SYSDATE )
